Subject: 5 stars — careful work and fast turnaround for our camera parts

5/5 stars

Arroyo made a camera-to-dewar adapter plate and a threaded light baffle tube for our near-IR camera. We needed the parts in time for our Palomar run on November 18, and they delivered in nine days from the purchase order, compared with their quoted 21 days. A larger vendor had quoted us six weeks, so the turnaround made a real difference to our schedule.

What impressed me even more was how carefully they read the drawing. Tiff noticed that I had put the adapter plate bolt circle in inches on a drawing where the other dimensions were in millimeters. I had copied it from an old camera drawing and missed the unit mismatch. Ruben checked with me before they cut anything, which caught my mistake before it became a very expensive problem. I really appreciate that they stopped to ask rather than just machining what was on the page.

We did the fit test on Monday and everything worked. All eight screws went into the plate without forcing, and flatness across the face was under 0.01 mm on the dial indicator. The baffle threads were smooth, and we saw no light leak in our dark test. The black anodizing was even, with no bare spots.

Ruben also drove the finished parts to Robinson himself, at no charge. I was so relieved to see them that I almost hugged him! They had already passed the shop’s inspection, and he included the inspection sheet.

For other labs and purchasing staff: this was a small, urgent two-part order, and our price included a rush setup fee, so I wouldn’t assume every job will have the same turnaround or cost. But in our case, Arroyo was fast, attentive to the drawing, and delivered parts that passed our fit and light-leak checks. Based on this experience, I’d absolutely use them again, and I’d like to see them added to our preferred vendor list.
